items.prompt: Explain, in detail, an experience you've had in the past 3 to 4 years related to your first-choice major. This can be an experience from an extracurricular activity, in a class you've taken, or through something else. Describe your personal and/or career goals after graduating from Illinois and how your selected first-choice major will help you achieve them.
items.ru: Эссе о специальности первого выбора: опыт за последние 3–4 года и цели после Illinois. Пишется в разделе Illinois в Common App, около 150 слов. Всего эссе Illinois 2–3.
items.evidence: First-year application includes 2-3 Illinois essays and one Common App essay . First-Year: Illinois Essays You'll answer these in the Writing section of the Illinois questions on the Common App. Each essay should be about 150 words .

items.prompt: Please explain your interest in your second-choice major or your overall academic or career goals.
items.ru: Дополнительное эссе, только если указана вторая специальность: почему она интересна или каковы ваши академические и карьерные цели.
items.evidence: Second-Choice Major Essay When you apply with a second-choice major, you'll answer this additional prompt. Please explain your interest in your second-choice major or your overall academic or career goals.

items.prompt: What are your future career or academic goals? You may include courses you took in high school and how these impacted your goals. What are your academic interests? Please include 2-3 majors you're considering at Illinois and why.
items.ru: Только для Undeclared: два вопроса вместо эссе о специальности первого выбора — о будущих целях и академических интересах, с 2–3 специальностями в Illinois.
items.evidence: If you're applying Undeclared… Complete these prompts instead of the standard first-choice major essay prompts.

items.ru: Портфолио обязательно для поступающих в School of Art and Design.

items.ru: Собеседование бывает в Music и Theatre: в Music — прослушивание или интервью, в Theatre — интервью и либо прослушивание, либо portfolio review. Зависит от программы.
